purpose: Internal coverage repair after the observed v2 composition gap; not a new independent evaluation
stratum_definition: method.tools == hands versus the other three declared tools; structural raw-input category, not a human difficulty label
assignment_rule: within stratum sort SHA256(salt,stratum,family_id); fixed train/val_internal/test_internal quotas
selection_inputs: family input values and declared quotas only; no reward, baseline scores, learned policy or optimal-cost results
world_ids_and_answers: preserve root/family IDs, responses, references and original split provenance; only this version's split membership changes
nonanswer_or_correction_derivatives: not added; future variants require shared-parent and effective-response duplicate grouping
known_infeasible_requirements: all four tool values in every split: val/test each have only three families
hands+gentle+pat_gently in every split: that indivisible family exists only once
